'''Shortened barrels''' were a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] modification available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The barrels were usually used by [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and plainclothes [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security forces]] to hide more easily their weapons. Several models of barrel were available, all costing about 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; these included [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries's]] [[SB4 shortened barrel]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[SBSS reduced length barrel]].
